items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: Yes I do. As a matter of fact Jerome Richardson told me that story but what do you know of it?

ctx.x: Yeah. Do you know the story of how he got known in New York?
Yes I do. As a matter of fact Jerome Richardson told me that story but what do you know of it?

Well they were like okay who’s this fat boy from down there in the south, okay let’s get rid of him you know. So he said whatever it was, “I Remember April” might have been the tune and they took it way uptempo and took it through the keys on him. They thought they were going to get rid of him. But that’s his thing. So he wailed. And next thing it was all over town, here’s this boy from down there in Florida who’s killing it.
